reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.
No catalytically inactive F1 counterfactual, and combined ADP/Pi omission does not establish each substrate requirement. No-F1 and stationary controls alone do not attribute synthesis to active F1.

checks.quote: applied torque exceeds the theoretical energy required
checks.reason: Two independent unit errors: torque cannot be directly compared with synthesis energy without an angular work integral; angular position is subsequently assigned degrees/sec, which is angular velocity. These are separate propositions, charged once each.

checks.quote: saturating concentrations of ADP and Pi
checks.reason: Substrate, ionic/buffer, temperature, volume and quench/measurement settings have no quantitative values or concrete calibration-to-choice procedure; one proposed speed and duration is insufficient.
Static luminescence calibration ignores reporter ATP consumption, time response and product-recovery mass balance; no independent recovery/interference acceptance and failure rule is given.
Fifty single molecules are not an identified independent chamber/preparation allocation design; no nesting, pilot variance or precision/power justification.
No randomized/balanced allocation or blinded/coded acquisition and analysis, or justified equivalent.
Prospective quality review is proposed, but operational exclusion thresholds, stopping policy and complete technical attrition versus biological nonresponse accounting are not specified.
The repeated allocation unit, independence/covariance assumptions, uncertainty and multiplicity procedure are unspecified; a named ANOVA alone does not resolve them.
Pilot ranges or variables are supplied, but no complete bounded exploration and objective setting-selection/lock before independent confirmation.
No explicit revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed/ambiguous exploratory work.

checks.quote: we conclude that F1 coupling is irreversible or slips
checks.reason: Verified reverse motion plus an undetectable ATP signal does not establish irreversibility without validated detection sensitivity, chemical conditions and retained catalytic competence. The positive rule also never inventories/exceeds prebound ATP.
No operational orthogonal chemical identity or synthesis validation beyond the same luciferase signal.
No complete preparation/chamber/raw-trajectory/chemical-sample/calibration manifest linked to analysis versions/settings, deviations and outputs.
